dedupe_keys.name: brainport automated valet parking pickup dlr automated vehicle

description: AUTOPILOT project partners publish separate automated valet-parking sessions involving TNO and DLR vehicles, roadside cameras and a parking-space inspection drone. Scenarios include commanded drop-off and pickup, obstacle-aware routing, camera parking occupancy and drone occupancy messages to the parking-management service. Coverage includes TNO sessions at the Automotive Campus; DLR sessions explicitly name its Brunswick test site, so the Brainport pilot label does not imply one Dutch location. Stream descriptions include vehicle controls, absolute/relative object detections, CAN dynamics, position and parking-command/status messages. One positioning product is resampled to 100 milliseconds, without that rate applying to every stream. Similar drop-off/pickup descriptions cover distinct native deposits and file inventories. The related deposits preserve those session identities without claiming independent statistical trials or absence of overlapping observations. Zenodo provides the described files free under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptions and file descriptors were inspected; archives, values, code and media remain unread. File availability does not verify completeness, internal formats or measurement quality.
